intro: Group terms and values in semantic definition lists. Choose stacked, inline or responsive layouts, and preserve links, code and multiple values inside descriptions.
useCases: Account settings, product specifications and API metadata.

faqs.question: Does this require another package?
faqs.answer: DescriptionList uses native dl, dt and dd elements with token-based responsive layouts. Import its compound members from ui/typography.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Responsive layouts switch at the md breakpoint. Use CSS variables for spacing and column proportions; nested lists configure their own layout. No table or grid ARIA roles are added.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Preserve native HTML semantics and meaningful link names. Keep headings aligned with the document outline, and provide alternate text for images.
